item.title: In 2016, NSW began fencing feral cats and foxes out of three reserves; 10 years later...
item.description: Thirteen native animal species have returned to New South Wales conservation reserves after a decade. These species had been locally extinct and are now breeding successfully within predator-proof fences. This conservation success is the result of a ten-year partnership involving government and scientific organizations. The state has now extended this vital conservation agreement for another ten years. Future efforts will focus on expanding these reintroductions beyond fenced areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Built in 1966, San Francisco's Empress of China closed in 2016; 10 years later it reopened its doors
item.description: The iconic Empress of China building in San Francisco has achieved community ownership after a decade-long effort. A coalition of six Asian American non-profits came together to acquire this historic site, aiming to convert it into a thriving arts and cultural campus. The restoration project aligns with broader economic and cultural revitalization goals, inviting future public sessions to influence its architectural evolution. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 2015, Hawaii rescued fragments of a coral found only in Kaneohe Bay; after its wild colonies...
item.description: Marine biologists rescued rare Hawaiian coral fragments from Kaneohe Bay in 2015. These fragments were grown into mature colonies using a land-based nursery method. The grown corals were then returned to their natural habitat in Kaneohe Bay. Field checks confirmed the reintroduced corals successfully adjusted to their surroundings. This project demonstrates the effectiveness of coral arks for preventing species extinction. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk
